name: Phi-4-multimodal-finetune-ko-speech
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Full fine-tune of microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct (5.57B) with the AUDIO ENCODER UNFROZEN, trained on 35K Korean speech/transcript pairs (zeroth_korean + Korean CommonVoice-17 + Korean MINDs14 + custom augmented data), 4 epochs, batch 16, single A100 80GB. Same tensor set as the base; this is not a merged adapter - the card's own ablation separates it from the LoRA route (LoRA: 2.72 CER / 7.19 WER). CAVEAT that matters for reading the rows: the base column is labelled 'original' and scores 99.16 CER / 99.63 WER on Korean, i.e. Phi-4-mm does not do Korean ASR at all, so most of the headline gap is new-language coverage rather than a capability delta between two working systems. The AST columns are a fairer comparison and there the margins are much smaller (+2.0 ko2en BLEU). Evaluations are small: 457 zeroth clips and 270 fleurs pairs. The card also flags regression against the older seastar105/Phi-4-mm-inst-zeroth-kor on ko2en-cot (9.19 vs 8.38), and calls itself a PoC, not production. Licence mit, repo created 2025-03-06.

benchmarks.name: zeroth_korean test CER
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | zeroth (CER) | zeroth (WER) | fleurs-ko2en | fleurs-ko2en-cot | fleurs-en2ko | fleurs-en2ko-cot |': row 'original' (base microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct) 99.16 vs 'Ours - speech full finetune (4 epochs)' 1.61. 457-sample zeroth test set, decoder = base with audio encoder unfrozen. Card notes the base row is ~chance for Korean (Phi-4-mm has no Korean ASR), so most of the gap is new-language coverage, not a like-for-like capability delta.

benchmarks.name: zeroth_korean test WER
benchmarks.config: Same card table, same rows: base 'original' 99.63 vs this model 3.54, 457 samples. Card's own LoRA-adapter ablation prints 7.19 WER / 2.72 CER for the adapter route, so the full-finetune win over LoRA is a real, card-measured internal comparison.

benchmarks.name: fleurs ko->en BLEU
benchmarks.config: Same card table, column 'fleurs-ko2en': base 5.63 vs this 7.67. 270-sample fleurs ko<->en speech-translation test intersection, ko-mecab tokenisation for en2ko columns. Evaluator gist linked on the card.

benchmarks.name: fleurs ko->en BLEU, chain-of-thought prompt
benchmarks.config: Same card table, column 'fleurs-ko2en-cot': base 2.42 vs this 8.38, 270 samples. Caveat printed on the card: AST quality 'deteriorates' relative to the older seastar105/Phi-4-mm-inst-zeroth-kor checkpoint (9.19) - and that cot column is the one this model loses there.

benchmarks.config: Same card table, column 'fleurs-en2ko': base 6.86 vs this 12.31, 270 samples, ko-mecab tokenisation.
